title: Bricks bricks bricks
description: a mod that adds just enough bricks for you to play with☻
body:
this mod adds a buch of bricks

iron bricks: if you craft a block of iron and put it in a stonecutter you get a iron brick 

copper bricks:if you craft a block of copper and put it in a stonecutter you get a copper brick

gold bricks:if you craft a block of gold and put it in a stonecutter you get a gold brick

emerald bricks:if you craft a block of emerald and put it in a stonecutter you get a emerald
brick

lapis bricks:if you craft a block of lapis and put it in a stonecutter you get a lapis brick

diamond bricks:if you craft a block of diamond and put it in a stonecutter you get a diamond brick

netherite bricks:if you craft a block of netherite and put it in a stonecutter you get a netherite brick

stone brick: you know that we can not use stone for tools or a furnace only cobblestone and you cant make a stone butto or pressure plate with a cobblestone block stone bricks are made for making tools and buttons and pressure plates

red nether brick: craft with 1 red dye inthe middle and 8 nether brick surrounding it can be used to make red nether brick blocks just craft stone bricks BUT replace the stone with red nether brick

mud brick:smelt a piece of mud in a furnace it can be used to make packed mud bricks blocks just craft stone bricks BUT replace the stone with mud brick

slime brick: right click on ground and you can squish it THAT'S IT!!!! oh yeah you can also use 4 slime balls to craft slime bricks just craft stone bricks but replace the stone with slimeballs

there is one more brick i did not tell you its a surprise ☻☻☻☻☻☻
